answer.worked:
This is exponential decay, so eliminate B and C. Check the $y$-intercept:
$$\begin{aligned}y &= 5^{-0}\\y &= 1\end{aligned}$$
The graph must pass through $(0,1)$. Eliminate A, which has no visible finite $y$-intercept. D shows decay from a finite positive $y$-intercept.

Correct answer: D.
